description: Combine HTML and CSS into a simple profile design.
definition: A profile card combines meaningful content with a small reusable layout.
rule: Use a class to style the card.
tip: Padding adds space inside the card.
caution: Keep text readable against the background.
exercise: Add your name, bio and a useful link.
title: Build a Profile Card with HTML and CSS
idea: HTML adds structure. CSS adds style.
